name: update-checker
description: A utility plugin for plugins to easily add update notifications.
author: joksulainen

notify_in_chat.description: Whether or not to post update notifications into the in-game chat. This is a short blurb if at least one plugin has an update.

check_interval.description: The interval in minutes at which the plugin will check for updates.

first_check_delay.description: The delay in seconds after which the plugin will check for updates on init.

ignored_plugins.description: A list of plugins that this plugin will not check updates for.
